notes: Validated against Lu et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2008. SAM-III (SMK box) from Enterococcus faecalis. SAM A:216. Adenosyl moiety stacks on A11/A57; methionine SD contacts A9/A10; aminocarboxylate contacts A8. Completely different fold from SAM-I (alpha helix) and SAM-II (pseudoknot). SR ions (strontium, crystallization) removed. GTP A:1 (5-terminal) included in receptor.
